environmentHint.checking: Checking access to the shared workbench.
environmentHint.api: Changes are shared with all reviewers.
environmentHint.unavailable: Shared work is unavailable. You can work locally.

nav.resetDescription: This permanently clears all saved interventions, information requests, account updates and preferences in this browser. The dashboard will reopen with the six original accounts.
nav.resetSharedDescription: This clears all plans, requests and owner updates in the shared demo for everyone, and frees both weekly slots.
nav.resetError: The reset did not finish. Check the current portfolio and try again.

resetHint.local: Clear saved work and settings here.
resetHint.api: Reset the shared board for everyone.

nav.author: Author

welcome.title: How would you like to start?
welcome.description: Track which customers are due to renew their contracts and decide who needs a follow-up.

demo.label: Watch a demo
demo.hint: Take the Quick Tour, then watch a sample customer’s renewal from start to finish.

tour.label: Take the Quick Tour
tour.hint: See where to find renewal dates, customer risks and your team’s workload.

explore.label: Explore on my own
explore.hint: Open the dashboard and choose a customer to review yourself.

demo.modeHint: The Quick Tour introduces the dashboard before the automated Ember demo.
demo.move: Drag the grip to swap Accounts and Portfolio value. All four cards can be moved.
demo.timeline: Open Ember’s renewal date on the daily timeline.
demo.queue: Choose Ember from the account queue.
demo.overview: Ember renews in {days} days. Budget approval is still pending.
demo.plan: Plan an intervention to confirm budget approval.
demo.owner: Assign a person to follow up with the budget approver.
demo.date: Choose a future follow-up date before renewal.
demo.save: Save the intervention. Ember now uses one of the two slots.
demo.actions: Open Owner actions to review the saved intervention.
demo.complete: Complete the intervention to release the slot.
demo.result: Ember’s intervention is complete and its slot is available again.
demo.keepHint: Continue keeps the card order and saves the example in Local if Ember has no plan and a slot is free. Reset demo discards the practice run.
demo.existingHint: Your existing local plans were preserved.
demo.error: The demo could not finish this step. You can start it again from the User menu.
demo.storeError: Could not save the example in this browser. Try again or reset the demo.

rateLimit.retryAfter: Try again in {seconds, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}}.

dashboard.noOwnerActions: There are no open issues or active interventions for the owner to update.
dashboard.chooseAccountHint: Select an account to review its renewal date, usage and open concerns.
dashboard.calendarHint: Annual contract value by renewal date (USD).
dashboard.emptyTimeline: No renewals in this date range.
dashboard.attentionHint: Open an account to review the concern before committing a slot.
dashboard.name: Account
dashboard.detail: Review the evidence for {name} and decide what to do next.

signals.ember: The sponsor is waiting for budget approval.
signals.beacon: Weekly adoption fell from {previous, number, percent} to {current, number, percent}. The sponsor is unreachable.
signals.cove: A critical issue is open. The sponsor remains positive.
signals.drift: Usage reporting failed. The sponsor’s view is unknown.
signals.atlas: Positive sponsor feedback. No open issues.
signals.field: The issue is resolved. Sponsor feedback is positive.
signals.coveResolved: The critical issue is resolved. Sponsor feedback is positive.

dashboard.empty: No accounts match your search or filters.
dashboard.order: Select a column heading to sort. Select it again to reverse the order.
dashboard.reportingFailed: No usage figure is available for this week.
dashboard.simulationNote: Record the owner’s next step here.

hypotheses.cove: The critical issue could delay renewal. Confirm its impact with the sponsor.
hypotheses.coveResolved: The issue has been resolved. Confirm the outcome at the next follow-up.
hypotheses.ember: The budget decision could delay renewal. Find out who approves it and when they expect to decide.
hypotheses.beacon: The drop in usage may put renewal at risk. Ask what changed before offering adoption support.
hypotheses.drift: Usage may have risen, fallen or stayed the same. Ask for a corrected report before choosing a next step.
hypotheses.field: The resolved issue and positive feedback suggest a routine check-in is enough.
hypotheses.atlas: Usage and sponsor feedback support a routine check-in.

dashboard.basis: Evidence at the time of the decision
dashboard.question: What do you need to find out?

actions.resolveIssue: Coordinate a fix for the critical issue

confirmed.information: Information request saved. No extra slot used.
confirmed.resolve: Critical issue marked resolved. The account’s status now reflects the update.
confirmed.complete: Intervention complete. One weekly slot is now free.

errors.ownerTooLong: Use at most 80 characters for the owner.
errors.questionTooLong: Use at most 400 characters for the question.
errors.invalidText: Remove invisible formatting or control characters.
errors.notApplicable: This account has no critical issue to resolve.
errors.invalidDate: Choose a follow-up date within the range shown above.
errors.ownerRequired: Enter the name of the person responsible for this intervention.
errors.questionRequired: Write the question you need answered.
errors.full: Both weekly slots are in use. Complete an active intervention to free a slot.
errors.changed: This account has changed. Reopen its details before trying again.
errors.storage: The update could not be confirmed. Check the current account and try again.

dashboard.storageError: Couldn’t load the latest work for this environment. Try again.
dashboard.awaitingSnapshot: Saved. Waiting for the shared board to refresh.
dashboard.publicText: This shared demo is public. Use fictional names and details.
dashboard.sharedOffline: Shared work is unavailable. Keep this account open to resume when it reconnects.
dashboard.noReview: No accounts are flagged for review.
dashboard.tourAccounts: Drag the grip on any of the four cards to rearrange the dashboard. Select Accounts to review a renewal.
dashboard.tourRange: Choose a start and end date, then select Apply range. The dashboard shows renewals in that period and remembers it when you return.
dashboard.tourRenewals: Select this card to see which accounts renew in the next 30 days. Check what needs attention before each deadline.
dashboard.tourAttention: Each flagged account has a reason to look closer. Read the concern alongside the renewal date before deciding who needs your help.
dashboard.tourQueue: After the tour, search for Drift and open its account. Usage is unknown. You can record what you need to find out before committing a slot.
dashboard.tourCapacity: You can work on two interventions at a time this week. Saving a new plan uses a slot. An information request leaves the count unchanged.
